description: "The Electoral Votes of 1876" by David Dudley Field is a historical account written in the late 19th century. This book delves into the contentious issues surrounding the counting and legitimacy of electoral votes during the disputed presidential election of 1876, focusing on the principles of democracy and the constitutional processes involved in counting the votes.
